environment.description: FastAPI service deployed on ECS Fargate behind an internal ALB (scheme=internal) in a shared VPC. ALB listener on port 443 with TLS termination using a server certificate only. No client certificate validation configured. Security groups allow inbound from 10.0.0.0/8 CIDR. Any pod/service/instance in the VPC can reach the ALB directly. No WAF attached to the ALB.
